'''Product Advertising''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Media Division]]. It designed, tested, and implemented all advertising campaigns for Authority products.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
